taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Sensitive image metadata retained through transformation and public delivery
controls.source_trace: Follow protected metadata through original, resized and cached variants. Establish whether the publisher intentionally authorizes the destination audience to receive it.
controls.implementation_branch: Inspect the delivered derivative, original-download path and CDN cache separately. Stripping visible EXIF fields may leave thumbnails, XMP or other containers; a server filename is not necessarily original metadata. Confirm a synthetic classified field survives the actual public delivery path, and distinguish deliberately published attribution from private location/device data.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned image with synthetic location/identity metadata and compare public/authorized output variants; do not collect real-user location data.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Metadata presence is not automatically a confidentiality violation; public photographer attribution and owner-requested original downloads can be intended.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Strip/protect sensitive fields according to policy across variants, preserving intended attribution and image quality.
